about: qccd-physics-best: the best published trapped-ion fidelity for each operation, each from its own experiment (no one machine has all of them yet); every other number is qccd-physics@2's (Helios, Quantinuum's transport). The Shor machine of docs/FULLSTACK_PLAN.md S9 runs on it under qccd-noise@2 at scale 1/2: every error half of today's best

heating.note: R17: accrues whether or not the ion moves. 29(4) quanta/s, the axial centre-of-mass mode of a Ba-Yb crystal in Quantinuum's junction trap

1q_gate.note: Clifford error 1.5(4)e-7 by randomized benchmarking, microwave gates on a 43Ca+ clock qubit; the duration stays physics@2's (5 us)

cool.note: the 300 us of cooling Helios applies after a shift, before the next gates. It leaves the floor n-bar 0.05 that qccd-noise@2 adds (arXiv:2206.11888, Fig. 3's Ba-Yb experiment); the replay counts heating from 0

gate_swap.note: 3 CX, distance-independent: the logical identity SWAP = CX CX CX, not a measured number

curve.label: physical swap of a two-ion crystal: 200 us, < 2 quanta per mode (the bound used as the value)

3.label: no extra time or excitation beyond the two 375 um legs it joins: a Ba-Yb crystal crosses at the same 4 m/s, and a whole round trip through it (four legs) adds <= 0.03 quanta, charged on the legs. Measured on an X junction; no Y-junction figure for a Ba-Yb crystal is published

4.label: no extra time or excitation beyond the two 375 um legs it joins: a Ba-Yb crystal crosses at the same 4 m/s, and a whole round trip through it (four legs) adds <= 0.03 quanta, charged on the legs

measure.note: Helios's SPAM error, 4.8(6)e-4, is mostly preparation (arXiv:2511.05465 p.7); the vendor's emulator splits it as p_meas 1e-6 and p_init 5e-4, which this block follows (reset.error). 120 us is H0's high-fidelity measurement
measure.source: arXiv:2511.05465 Table II; Quantinuum Helios-1E emulator parameters (p_meas); duration arXiv:2003.01293 Table III

curve.label: combine: 128 us, < 1 quantum per mode (the bound used as the value)

ms_gate.chain_note: the chain-length term of Murali et al. (arXiv:2004.04706 Eq. 1, ISCA 2020): A ~ N/ln N, referenced to the two-qubit gate the fidelity was measured on
ms_gate.note: the 'smooth gate': two-qubit error 8.4(7)e-5 without ground-state cooling, and <= 5e-4 up to n-bar 9.4(3) on the gate mode, i.e. (5e-4 - 8.4e-5) / 9.4 = 4.4e-5 per quantum (derived, an upper bound). Two electronically controlled ions; the gate time and chain factor stay physics@2's. max_quanta is R7's gate budget, a rule of the boards

reset.note: heralded preparation and measurement: SPAM infidelity 7e-6 (optical qubit; 5e-6 and 8e-6 for the other two 137Ba+ encodings), all of it charged to the reset, the measurement keeping physics@2's 1e-6. Heralding discards failed preparations; their time is not charged here (the reset keeps physics@2's 10 us)

curve.label: one zone pitch, 375 um at 4 m/s (derived: 94 us), the speed at which a Ba-Yb crystal gains <= 0.03 quanta per round trip of four such legs (derived: 0.0075 per leg)
split: 128 us, < 1 quantum per mode (the bound used as the value)

species.note: Helios pairs each 137Ba+ qubit with one 171Yb+ coolant. T_coh_s (derived) is 1/r for the Helios linear memory rate r = 7.9e-3/s, so the coarse idle estimate of qccd.cost.physical agrees with qccd-noise@2's memory channel
